scope: Only finite point-preprocessing confirmation. V1/V2/V3 unchanged. No new completion, interpolation, saturation or row/channel deletion model.
detector_definition: Union legacy MAD and V2 auxiliary candidates. Conservative candidate needs both-axis z>=8, original-data residual to rank4 estimate of candidate-masked data >=6 robust channel scales, matching signs against leave-center temporal and spectral medians, agreement between their references, exteriority beyond eight axial neighbor range, small 8-connected component, no temporal persistence of spectral prominence, no nearby top code. All evidence is statistical, not instrument fault confirmation.
new_regions: 32x256 panels centered in gap between old V2 slots3 and4; columns64 development,900 and1720 confirmation. No overlap with old local V2 or V3 panels. Full heats historically studied: not external validation.

injections.explain: Spike adds fraction of within-panel 95%-5% range with minimum range5000, capped at64000; drop multiplies by 1-strength. Locations spaced in time/wavelength, injected values never become top codes. Truth is actual changed cells only. No clean-reference exclusion based on detector.

controls: Unmodified new panels; original high-prominence channels and fastest integral-change frames checked for inadvertent modification. Original raw data is noisy, not pristine truth. Persistent-line synthetic counterexample only tests false deletion, not actual fault accuracy.
solver: Unmodified V3 model3.solve fixed rank4 eta.003. All validation strategies same max300 stop1e-4 and guards; frozen finite-budget comparison. Final native selected-mask fits use existing stable_completion 600/1200 plus predeclared visible-only linear fallback and wall360s. Saturation record strategy and conditional estimates reuse V3.
primary_metrics: Absolute detection precision/recall/F1 without excluding pre-existing statistical candidates; pollution-region RMSE; unpolluted-region RMSE and changed fraction; whole-matrix RMSE before/after; full-spectrum integral, true-reference peaks and unsupported peak risk. Ordinary missing recovery is not the selection endpoint.

selection_rule.details: On development, added repair must pass ALL gates. Among passing conservative/P1 choose smallest unpolluted change fraction, then pollution RMSE. Otherwise P0. Lock before opening confirmation. Confirm same gates; failed confirmation leads declared P0 fallback, not retuning. No threshold search. Original raw-point selection cannot be justified only by synthetic F1.

final_acceptance: Statistical repair supported by multi-evidence plus end-to-end confirmation; never confirmed hardware fault. Kept points exactly preserved, zero negative nodes/dense, top codes retained, no whole rows deleted. If no repair selected, explicitly label diagnosis and faithful reconstruction only, not actual anomaly removal.
no_new_literature_claim: Use previously read V1/V2/V3 robust-statistics and low-rank sources. Rules are task-specific conservative heuristics, not a new proven detector or calibrated fault probability.
